newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crop progress highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crop progress highlights - USDA.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Monday said one percent of the U.S. winter wheat crop was in very poor condition, five percent in poor, 24 percent fair, 55 percent good and 15 percent excellent.
In its report on April 6 conditions, USDA said one percent of the spring wheat crop had been planted compared with one percent the same period a year ago, and the five-year average of three percent.
USDA said three percent of the corn crop was planted versus two percent the same period a year ago, and two percent average.
The department also reported six percent of the cotton crop was planted, compared with six percent in the same period in 1996 and the five-year average of six percent.
Eleven percent of the sorghum crop was planted, compared to 14 percent one year ago and the five-year average of 15 percent.
